title: Mazungumzo ya papo kwa hapo. (Theme 9: Hospitalini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child keeps to the topic, waits for his turn, and says each sentence in clear Kiswahili with a matching face and hand.

floor.prerequisite: Answers a simple question about himself in a full sentence.
floor.question: Unapenda kula nini?

representations: a topic picture in the middle of the group
a word wall of Kiswahili words
steps: Say one sentence on the topic.
contexts: talking with a parent at home

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says two sentences on the topic, waiting for his turn.

misconceptions.repair: Tunazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari; sema jambo kuhusu hilo.

misconceptions.ask: Ni nani ana zamu ya kuzungumza sasa?
misconceptions.repair: Subiri zamu yako; msikilize mwenzako kwanza.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hilo kwa Kiswahili ni lipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema: Daktari alinidunga sindano.

misconceptions.ask: Ujumbe wako ni wa furaha au wa huzuni?

misconceptions.repair: Tamka "rafiki" kwa /r/: ulimi unagonga mara moja.

checks.question: Daktari alinipa injection. Sema kwa Kiswahili.
